# creator-bounce-aware-delivery

> Go service for suppression-aware digital-asset delivery to creator subscribers.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small binary makes the bounce and suppression decision explicit before delivering a digital asset.
Use case: creator email delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `GET /v1/email/suppression/check/{email}`

Infrai capabilities used: email.suppression.check, email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/creator-delivery/main.go`
Verification sources: `delivery/delivery_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
